methodology.overlap: Independent zone rows can share identical entry, SL and TP. Unique execution totals merge those rows.
methodology.trendlines: Same-direction continuation or breakout evidence on H1 or higher, confirmed by the signal close. No touch or proximity required.
methodology.invalidation: Completed candle entirely beyond Fib 0.79, including wicks.
methodology.costs: No spread, slippage or commission model.
methodology.sample: 500 completed H1 bars; 15M/30M entry confirmations; history is reconstructed at each confirmation.
